messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered for hosted-api — severity=P2. eu-central-1 GPU pool at 100% utilization, request queue rising rapidly, p95 ~4.2s, p99 ~18s. Autoscaler reports repeated create failures.

maria (eng-oncall): I'm on it. grabbing dashboards + logs. which customer traffic spike?

jess (support): Seeing increased 504/timeout reports from partner-rtu and a few small enterprise tenants in EU. Support is triaging tickets, flagging high-visibility app A.

sanjay (sre): autoscaler logs show cloud API returns `InsufficientCapacityError` and `QuotaExceeded` intermittently. stack: autoscaler -> provisioner -> cloud-apis.

devon (infra-oncall): confirmed. tried to expand dedicated-pool-eu by 10 but provider rejected: `Quota exceeded for resource 'NVIDIA_A100' in region eu-central-1`. Also one create failed with `ServiceUnavailable` from provider across multiple zones.

maria (eng-oncall): ok. immediate mitigations: 1) enable routing fallback to quantized smaller model for non-SLAs 2) opt-in best-effort region spill to us-east 3) enable early-shed for long-running requests (soft-429).

alice (product): pls prioritize preventing customer A outages — they have strict SLAs. can we route only their traffic to dedicated reserved pool?

devon (infra-oncall): we can route tenant-specific tokens to reserved-dedicated-eu if creds exist. reserved pool usage currently at 72% but has headroom for critical tenants. will carve + pin.

maria (eng-oncall): doing quick routing change now for tenant A. command:```sh
redwoodctl route update --tenant tenant-A --pool reserved-dedicated-eu --priority 1
```

ops-bot: routing update applied for tenant-A -> reserved-dedicated-eu. live in ~12s. :white_check_mark:

jess (support): saw reduced errors for tenant A immediately, thank you. still seeing 504s for partner-rtu and some non-SLA customers.

sanjay (sre): starting quantized fallback for non-SLA traffic. patching policy:```json
{"path":"/v1/generate","policy":{"fallback_model":"opt-ql32-small","criteria":"non_sla"}}
```

ops-bot: degraded-mode toggled for non-SLA traffic. docs: https://intranet/redwood/runbook/degraded-routing

devon (infra-oncall): attempted to restart autoscaler to clear transient errors: `systemctl restart redwood-autoscaler`. restart succeeded but subsequent scale attempts still failing due to cloud quotas.

maria (eng-oncall): what's the ETA from cloud for capacity? any open support case?

devon (infra-oncall): opened urgent quota request with cloud: case #CLD-987654. initial response says spare capacity is low tonight due to partner booking; estimated 2–6 hours unless we move to other region.

alice (product): can we failover EU traffic to us-east for the burst window? what is impact on latency/PCI?

sanjay (sre): failover will increase p95 by ~30–60ms for most customers but adds cross-region egress. PCI customers are pinned and won't be auto-moved. non-pci tenants can be routed to us-east.

maria (eng-oncall): initiating cross-region spill for best-effort routes. command:```sh
redwoodctl cluster-route set --region-preference eu-central,us-east --spill-threshold 80
```

ops-bot: cluster-route updated. Spill policy will start shifting new requests when eu-central queue > 80%.

jess (support): posting incident note to customers impacted (partner-rtu) and advising degraded perf + retries. drafting message for SRE-runbook.

devon (infra-oncall): manual pool spin-up attempt in alternative zones failed once due to `ServiceUnavailable`. next plan: create smaller flavor nodes (mixed GPU types) and use model compilation profile that supports heterogeneous pools. doing that now.

sanjay (sre): starting a fast compile fallback for small GPU types: `compile-profile --target=mixed-gpu --model=opt-ql32-large` to keep throughput.

maria (eng-oncall): status summary for handoff to devon at +35m: eu-central saturation persists, autoscaler unable to provision due to cloud quota/capacity. tenant-A routed to reserved pool (stable). non-SLA traffic routed to quantized fallback and spill to us-east. support notified. next actions: pursue quota escalation with cloud, continue heterogeneous pool spin-up, monitor p99 and queue depth. devon taking over.

devon (infra-oncall): taking the handoff. I've got the quota case + cloud rep on chat, spinning mixed-gpu pool, and will coordinate a limit increase if they can free capacity. if cloud can't, we'll keep degraded-mode and extend spill. will update every 15m.

alice (product): thanks both. please keep me posted before any customer-facing status page update.

jess (support): sent targeted status note to partner-rtu and three enterprise tenants. included workaround and expected timeline 2–6h.

incident-bot: incident channel updated: status=mitigated-degraded, owners=devon,maria, pager cleared for oncall rotation.

ops-bot: recommended post-incident followups: 1) adjust autoscaler backoff config 2) add pre-authorized quota buffer for eu region 3) test heterogeneous-pool failover in staging. link: https://intranet/redwood/incidents/after-action-template

devon (infra-oncall): noted. creating follow-up tickets now. will include timeline and cloud case details.

maria (eng-oncall): thanks team, handing off to devon for the next 2 hours. I'll remain available for model fallback issues. good job coordinating. :team-heart:
